name: @pipeworx/mcp-yelp

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search for local businesses and restaurants on Yelp by term and location. Returns matching businesses with star ratings, review counts, price, categories, address, and phone. Example: search_businesses({ term: "pizza", location: "San Francisco, CA" }).

location.description: Location to search, e.g. "San Francisco, CA" or "New York". Provide this OR latitude+longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search center. Use with longitude instead of location.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search center. Use with latitude instead of location.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 50).

price.description: Price filter as comma-separated levels 1-4, e.g. "1,2,3" for $ to $$$.

open_now.description: If true, only return businesses currently open.

_apiKey.description: Required — your own Yelp Fusion key. Pipeworx fronts no platform key for Yelp (Fusion plan is $229/mo, #2275 open); every call is refused with none.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get full details for a single Yelp business by its id or alias. Returns rating, review count, price, categories, address, phone, hours, photos, and coordinates. Example: get_business({ id: "garaje-san-francisco" }).

id.description: Yelp business id or alias (from search_businesses results).

_apiKey.description: Required — your own Yelp Fusion key. Pipeworx fronts no platform key for Yelp (Fusion plan is $229/mo, #2275 open); every call is refused with none.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: ⚠️ UPSTREAM-UNRELIABLE — Yelp Fusion's /reviews endpoint has been 404-ing on most ids since mid-2026 even for valid businesses. PREFER `get_business` (which sometimes inlines a snippet) or `search_businesses` for review-context queries. If you must call get_reviews: pass the ENCRYPTED business id (long alphanumeric, e.g. "WavvLdfdP6g8aZTtbBQHTw") returned in search_businesses results — aliases / slugs (e.g. "garaje-san-francisco") reliably 404. Returns up to 3 review snippets per business (rating, text, author, timestamp); "limit" is capped by Yelp upstream regardless of what you pass.

id.description: Yelp business id or alias (from search_businesses results).

limit.description: Number of reviews to return (default 3, max 50).

_apiKey.description: Required — your own Yelp Fusion key. Pipeworx fronts no platform key for Yelp (Fusion plan is $229/mo, #2275 open); every call is refused with none.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-yelp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the yelp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
